India’s electronics manufacturing ecosystem is expanding across automotive, consumer electronics, telecommunications, medical devices and industrial applications, increasing demand for reliable PCB manufacturing and assembly capabilities. For OEMs, electronics startups and product companies, choosing among PCB manufacturers in India involves more than comparing price or production capacity. PCB technology, quality standards, material capabilities, assembly expertise and production scalability all matter.

In India, where the electronics sector reached $115 billion in FY24, PCBs are at the core of an impressive array of devices, including the 1.15 billion mobile phones in use nationwide, as well as electric vehicles and 5G infrastructure. As we look ahead to 2026, India’s pcb manufacturing company leaders are poised to play a pivotal role, driving innovation and strengthening the nation’s position in the global electronics landscape.

Who are the key players shaping this future? Whether you’re an OEM seeking dependable (https://karkhana.io/pcb-assembly/) PCB assembly, a startup developing a ground breaking product, or simply interested in India’s technological ascent, this blog offers an in-depth exploration.

In this guide, we highlights 10 PCB manufacturers and electronics manufacturing companies in India and looks at the capabilities that set them apart. The list covers companies involved in different areas of PCB manufacturing, fabrication, assembly and electronics production, so buyers can better understand where each manufacturer fits within the wider electronics supply chain.

The Vital Role of PCBs in India’s Electronics Surge

To understand the significance of these manufacturers, it’s worth considering why PCBs are so essential. A PCB serves as the foundation of any electronic device, providing a structured platform where copper traces link components on a base material, often FR-4 fiberglass. This transforms a collection of parts into a functional system—whether it’s a straightforward LED light or a sophisticated board powering advanced technology.

Government initiatives like “Make in India” are amplifying this momentum, encouraging domestic production to reduce reliance on imports and bolster local innovation. With the electronics industry valued at $115 billion in FY24, PCB manufacturers are rising to meet the needs of diverse sectors, from consumer electronics to industrial applications. As 2026 approaches, these companies are not merely keeping up—they’re setting the standard.

PCB requirements also vary considerably by application. Consumer devices may require compact, high-density boards, while automotive, medical and industrial electronics often place greater emphasis on reliability, thermal performance, traceability and long-term operating conditions. As a result, the capabilities of PCB manufacturers in India can differ significantly depending on the technologies, materials, board types and production volumes they support.

The companies below represent different segments of India’s PCB manufacturing and electronics production ecosystem, from dedicated PCB fabrication to PCB assembly and broader EMS capabilities.

The Top 10 PCB Manufacturers in India for 2026

1.Karkhana.io – Redefining EMS Excellence

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra (HQ), with a pan-India supplier network

Specialty: Turnkey PCB assembly and EMS

What Sets Them Apart: Karkhana.io is a comprehensive (https://karkhana.io/electronic-manufacturing-services/)  Electronic Manufacturing Service Company (EMS provider), serving over 100 clients across automotive, healthcare, and (https://karkhana.io/the-top-10-consumer-electronics-companies-in-the-world-leaders-innovators-and-their-supply-chains/) consumer electronics. With a Class 100K cleanroom, our end-to-end electronics manufacturing support spans component sourcing, PCB assembly, and production support, with capabilities ranging from small-batch production to high-volume manufacturing. This allows us to support varying production requirements while maintaining quality and process control.

2. Ascent Circuits Pvt. Ltd. – Multilayer PCB Manufacturing and Export

Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu

Specialty: Single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: Ascent Circuits is a prominent exporter, sending over half of its PCBs to the U.S. market. Their fully automated facility employs advanced techniques like reverse pulse plating to ensure precise copper traces, catering to industries such as aerospace, telecommunications, and defense with a reputation for quality and consistency.

3. Genus Electrotech Ltd. – Multilayer and Metal-Core PCB Manufacturing

Location: Gandhidham, Gujarat

Specialty: Single-sided, double-sided, multilayer, and metal-core PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: Certified with ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015, Genus Electrotech offers a comprehensive approach, managing the entire process from bare PCBs to finished products. They serve consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial automation sectors, leveraging a modern facility and a skilled workforce.

4. Circuit Systems India Ltd. – Multilayer and Specialty PCB Manufacturing

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Specialty: Multilayer and specialty PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: Established in 1995, Circuit Systems has built a strong foundation serving telecommunications, defense, and automotive industries. Their Gujarat facility produces boards from standard FR-4 to aluminum bases, offering integrated services that include design, prototyping, and assembly.

5. Shogini Technoarts Pvt. Ltd. – Multilayer and Metal-Clad PCBs

Location: Pune, Maharashtra

Specialty: Single-sided to multilayer (up to 8 layers), metal-clad PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: Since its inception in 1979, Shogini has honed its expertise in producing durable PCBs for automotive, LED lighting, and power electronics applications. Based in Pune, they’re known for boards that withstand demanding conditions.

6. CIPSA-TEC India Pvt. Ltd. – Multilayer and Metal-Clad PCB Manufacturing

Location: Tumkur, Karnataka

Specialty: Single-sided, double-sided, multilayer, and HDI PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: With over 40 years of experience and partnerships with Spain’s CIPSA and Italy’s TECNOMEC, CIPSA-TEC combines international technology with local production. Certified with ISO 9001:2008 and TS-16949:2009, they excel in automotive and telecommunications, supported by full PCB assembly lines.

7. Meena Circuits Pvt. Ltd. – Multilayer and Metal-Core PCB Manufacturing

Location: Vadodara, Gujarat

Specialty: Single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: Through a technology collaboration with U.S.-based Amitron Corporation, Meena Circuits delivers high-quality boards for medical, industrial, and automotive applications. Their emphasis on precision has built a strong reputation.

Looking to 2026: Meena is strengthening its role in global supply chains, enhancing multilayer capabilities for industries with critical needs.

8. PCB Power Market Pvt. Ltd. – Custom PCB Prototyping and Assembly

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Specialty: Custom PCBs, prototyping, and assembly

What Sets Them Apart: Operating since 2006, PCB Power supports innovation with prototyping and PCB assembly services for telecommunications, medical, and consumer electronics. Their UL-certified facility ensures quality while keeping costs competitive.

Looking to 2026: They’re prioritizing rapid prototyping to serve India’s burgeoning startup ecosystem, offering fast solutions for small-batch production.

9. Hi-Q Electronics Pvt. Ltd. – High-Reliability and HDI PCB Manufacturing

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Specialty: Full range of PCB solutions, including design support

What Sets Them Apart: Since 1992, Hi-Q has been a trusted name in Bengaluru, serving defense, aerospace, and telecommunications with high-reliability PCBs. They provide design assistance alongside production, meeting stringent industry standards.

Looking to 2026: Hi-Q is enhancing its design support for complex multilayer PCBs, aligning with India’s efforts to modernize its defense sector.

10. AT&S India Pvt. Ltd. – HDI and High-Density PCB Manufacturing

Location: Nanjangud, Karnataka

Specialty: High-density interconnect (HDI), multilayer, and flexible PCBs

What Sets Them Apart: As a subsidiary of Austria’s AT&S, this Karnataka-based manufacturer brings international expertise to India. They produce PCBs for telecommunications—such as 5G infrastructure—along with automotive and medical applications. Holding ISO 9001 certification, AT&S excels in creating high-reliability boards with fine features like microvias and flexible designs suited for advanced technology.

What Distinguishes These Manufacturers in 2026?

Each of these manufacturers brings different capabilities to India’s PCB and electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Some focus on advanced PCB technologies, while others differentiate themselves through export capabilities, industry experience, or integrated manufacturing services.

Technological Capabilities: AT&S India and Hi-Q Electronics offer advanced PCB technologies, including HDI and high-density boards, while Shogini Technoarts and Meena Circuits specialise in multilayer and metal-core or metal-clad PCB solutions for specific applications.

Global and Industry Experience: Ascent Circuits has an established export-oriented manufacturing presence, while companies such as Genus Electrotech, Shogini Technoarts and Hi-Q Electronics serve diverse sectors including automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense.

Production Scalability: Manufacturers cater to different production requirements, from prototyping and smaller production runs to high-volume manufacturing. The ability to maintain consistent quality while scaling production is increasingly important for OEMs and product companies.

Integrated Manufacturing Support: Karkhana.io differentiates itself through its broader EMS capabilities, combining component sourcing, PCB assembly and production support with the ability to serve requirements ranging from small-batch to high-volume manufacturing.

In 2026, these differences matter because choosing a PCB manufacturing partner is increasingly about finding the right combination of technology, industry experience, production capability and manufacturing support.

Key Trends Shaping Their 2026 Success

Several trends are propelling these manufacturers forward as 2026 approaches:

Electric Vehicle Growth: Companies like Shogini and Ascent are well-positioned to supply metal-clad and multilayer PCBs for EV systems, such as battery management.

5G Expansion: AT&S and CIPSA-TEC’s focus on HDI boards supports the rollout of faster, more reliable telecommunications networks.

IoT Opportunities: Karkhana.io and PCB Power are ready to meet the surge in smart devices, delivering compact, efficient PCBs.

Local Manufacturing Push: Genus and Meena align with efforts to boost domestic production, enhancing India’s self-reliance in electronics.

These trends highlight why these manufacturers are critical to India’s evolving tech landscape, driving innovation across multiple sectors.

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q1. Who are the top 10 PCB manufacturing companies in India?

The top 10 PCB manufacturing companies in India include Karkhana.io, Ascent Circuits, Genus Electrotech, Circuit Systems, Shogini Technoarts, CIPSA-TEC, Meena Circuits, PCB Power Market, Hi-Q Electronics, and AT&S India. Their capabilities vary across PCB fabrication, specialised PCB technologies, PCB assembly and broader electronics manufacturing services.

Q2. Why is PCB manufacturing in India growing rapidly?

PCB manufacturing in India is being driven by increasing electronics production across automotive, consumer electronics, telecommunications, medical devices, industrial equipment and connected products. Government initiatives like ‘Make in India’ supporting domestic electronics manufacturing and the expansion of India’s electronics supply chain are also contributing to demand for local PCB manufacturing and assembly capabilities.

Q3. What makes a PCB manufacturing company reliable?

A reliable PCB manufacturing company should have the appropriate PCB technology and production capacity for the application, along with documented quality processes, relevant certifications, inspection and testing capabilities, and the ability to maintain consistent production as volumes increase. For OEMs, component sourcing, PCB assembly and production support can also be important considerations.

Q4. How do the top 10 PCB manufacturers in India differ from others?

PCB manufacturers differ in the technologies they support, industries they serve and the stages of manufacturing they handle. Some specialise in multilayer, HDI, flexible or metal-core PCBs, while others provide PCB assembly, component sourcing or broader electronics manufacturing services. Production volumes and industry-specific experience can also vary significantly.

Q5. Why should OEMs and startups consider PCB manufacturing India-based companies?

India offers an expanding electronics manufacturing ecosystem with capabilities spanning PCB fabrication, assembly and broader EMS. Working with an India-based manufacturing partner can provide access to local sourcing and production capabilities while supporting prototype, low-volume and higher-volume requirements, depending on the manufacturer’s capabilities.
